notes.title: Steam Achievements Overhaul
notes.notes: The Rounded Hills Achievements have been updated! There are now new images for all achievements. Check them out!

notes.title: 7 Months on Steam - Thank you!
notes.notes:
Rounded Hills is available on steam for about 7 months and there have been about 700 activations until now! Thank you very much for playing Rounded Hills!

Stay tuned for more games being released! :)
